verdict.rationale: Mailgun has extensive documented public REST APIs, SDKs across languages, Postman collections, and an llms.txt for AI discoverability, all supporting programmatic/agentic control of email sending, receiving, tracking, and domain management. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probe found 404s across standard paths) and independent hands-on verification of API robustness for AI-driven use.
